scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts src/visual.ts src/card-study.ts src/play-area-entry.ts --outdir public/build --target browser --minify --external /wasm/*
scripts.dice:build: bun build src/dice-study.ts --outdir public/build --target browser --minify && cp node_modules/dddice-js/LICENSE public/build/dddice-LICENSE.txt && cp node_modules/dddice-js/dddice-latest.js.LICENSE.txt public/build/dddice-latest.web.mjs.LICENSE.txt
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src server.ts package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js
scripts.visual:assets: uv run --with pillow python generate_visual_assets.py && bun generate-visual-models.ts
